---
title: Jira (PSOM)
---

Metrics in this section are calculated from PSOM Jira Service Management ticket
data.

The relevant Jira tables are:

- [`jira.psom`](../catalog/jira/psom.qmd) - daily snapshot of all PSOM tickets
- [`jira.psom_sla`](../catalog/jira/psom_sla.qmd) - the SLA clocks on each
  ticket, one row per ticket per SLA
- [`jira.psom_comment`](../catalog/jira/psom_comment.qmd) - every comment on
  each ticket

**Data cadence.** The tables are updated once per day (at ~06:00 ET); before
2026-09-29 they were updated weekly, on Mondays. Each run writes a full
snapshot of all tickets currently in the project to a new `date=` partition;
previous partitions are preserved as an audit trail. Always filter to
`date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM <table>)` when querying the latest state. Join
the tables on `key` and `date`.
